title: Unconscious
short_description: Topics referred to by the same term

sections.Physiology: - Unconsciousness, the lack of consciousness or responsiveness to people and other environmental stimuli
sections.Psychology:
- Unconscious mind, the mind operating well outside the attention of the conscious mind as defined by Sigmund Freud and others
- Unconscious, an altered state of consciousness with limited conscious awareness
- Not conscious
sections.Philosophy, spirituality: - Unconscious spirit, the supposed part of the human spirit or soul operating outside of conscious awareness
sections.Media: - Unconscious (2014), UK release title of Amnesiac, an American mystery film
